Compare Pre-coding Proxy Metrics with Oracle Metrics

Source: R/strata_functions.R
compare_oracle_vs_precoding.Rd

Creates a combined table and visualization comparing the pre-coding proxy metrics (based only on Yhat) with oracle metrics (based on actual residuals) for multiple candidate stratifications. This validates whether the pre-coding metrics successfully identify stratifications that perform well in practice.

compare_oracle_vs_precoding(
  oracle_comparison,
  precoding_comparison,
  top_n = 10
)

Arguments

oracle_comparison

Output from compare_stratifications, which uses actual residuals (Yobs - Yhat).

precoding_comparison

Output from compare_stratifications_precoding, which uses only Yhat as a proxy.

top_n

Integer specifying how many top stratifications to include in the output. Default is 10.

Value

A list with three elements:

combined_table

Data frame merging oracle and pre-coding metrics for each stratification, with columns for both metric types and rank comparisons.

correlation

Spearman correlation between oracle and pre-coding rankings, measuring how well pre-coding metrics predict oracle performance.

plot

A ggplot object showing the relationship between pre-coding and oracle metrics.

Details

This function is useful for validating that the pre-coding proxy metrics (which can be computed before any human coding is done) successfully identify stratifications that would perform well according to the oracle metrics (which require knowing the true residuals).

The key comparison is between:

  • mean_spread (oracle): Variance of mean residuals across strata (BS component)

  • mean_spread (pre-coding): Variance of mean Yhat across strata (proxy for BS)

High correlation between rankings suggests the pre-coding metrics are reliable for selecting stratifications in practice.

See also

compare_stratifications, compare_stratifications_precoding
